description:
Cron HEARTBEAT that (re)starts the singleton drain-until-caught-up embedder for the LED-01 event-content search index. Each fire does ZERO embedding on the action-queue thread: it submits ONE background drainer to a single-slot executor and returns in milliseconds with `{"drainer": "started", "page_size": N}`, or `{"drainer": "already_running", ...}` if a drainer is already active (that fire is a no-op). At most one drainer runs at a time PER PROCESS — a dedicated in-memory executor slot (separate from the auto-summarize slot, so the two drains run independently) is the singleton guard.

The drainer (`EventEmbeddingWriter.drain_missing_events`) walks a DURABLE cursor forward in ARRIVAL order — keyed on `imported_at` (platform receive time, per-row `now()` at append, index `idx_event_imported_at`), NOT vendor `event_at`. This is load-bearing: `event_at` is vendor wall-clock, so a historical session imported AFTER the cursor advanced (a cloud/export/history backfill — the ledger's routine load) carries an OLD `event_at`, and an `event_at` frontier would strand it in a permanent silent gap; arrival time is monotonic with insertion, so a late historical import always sorts AFTER the cursor and is caught. Each page it reads `list_event_embedding_candidates` (default `page_size` 100, clamped to the read's 1..100 cap; ordered `imported_at, id` ascending) — the SQL scope legs (`event_type = MESSAGE`, `role` in user/assistant, `content_text` not null) plus the Python leg (the Codex `reasoning` subtype exclusion) — asks the vector store which chunk-0 external_ids are missing, embeds those events via the LOCAL embedding model (no inference — nomic locally, titan on cloud), and advances + PERSISTS the cursor (a single `imported_at` timestamp) to the page's last row. The cursor is a single GLOBAL key-value row (`session_ledger`/`event_embed_cursor`); the drain restarts INCLUSIVELY at it (an empty-string id sentinel that sorts before every uuid) so same-arrival ties re-surface and are `find_missing`-skipped.

Four properties. O(N) BACKFILL, O(new) STEADY STATE: a caught-up fire reads only arrivals past the cursor, not a full-corpus rescan every fire. RECONCILIATION (hard completeness): every Nth fire IGNORES the cursor and re-checks the whole corpus — `imported_at` is assigned in Python BEFORE the autocommit insert, so it is not commit-visibility-monotonic and a row can commit into visibility BELOW the advanced cursor; the periodic full `find_missing` sweep re-reads and embeds it, making completeness a hard EVENTUAL guarantee (bounded by one reconcile interval), not probabilistic. RESTART-RESUMABLE: a mid-backfill process restart resumes at the persisted cursor. TRANSIENT-SAFE / POISON-LOUD: a page whose embed RAISES does NOT advance the cursor — the fire halts (`halted_on_error` true) and the next heartbeat retries the same page once the embedder recovers (idempotent delete-before-store + skip-existing means no double work), so a genuinely un-embeddable event re-surfaces loudly every fire rather than being silently skipped into a gap.

This is the LED-01 steady-state that mirrors `summarize_quiescent_sessions` for the EVENT corpus (operator directive: embedding runs automatically, the same manner as auto-summarize) — cron-fired via `ensure_periodic_embed_schedule`, the whole historical backlog fills in the background with no operator loop.

EDGE_SINK (terminal/headless) — no `result_processor_customizations` / `error_processor_customizations`; the cron-fired action short-circuits at the EDGE_SINK_SKIP branch in `action_queue_poller`. See `21_scheduling_service/01_template_flow_record_lifecycle.md` for the terminal-cron pattern.
embedding_description: Internal cron-fired heartbeat that starts a singleton drain-until-caught-up embedder over not-yet-embedded USER/ASSISTANT ledger message events, walking a durable ARRIVAL-time (imported_at, not vendor event_at) cursor forward so a caught-up fire embeds only new arrivals and a late historical import is still caught, while a periodic full reconciliation sweep re-checks the whole corpus to catch any row that committed below the cursor. Embeds via the local embedding model, not inference. A page that fails to embed does not advance the cursor and retries next fire. The LED-01 event-content steady-state sibling of the auto-summarize heartbeat; fills the historical backlog in the background with no operator loop.
